How Small Models Are
Changing AI
By Maya Rahman
The Daily Ledger
Apr 22, 2025 • 5 min read
4
Smaller language models are becoming more practical
for real-world use, offering many of the same
capabilities as larger systems at a fraction of the cost.
They can run on everyday devices, respond quickly,
and require less computing power.
As a result, small models are expanding access to AI
and opening up new possibilities for developers,
businesses, and individual users.
